approval_case.title: Recover the real Codex intake timeout
approval_case.situation: The existing Gym learning task timed out while indexing two Codex archives inside the shared daemon. The timeout happened before review, so no evidence or checkpoint was written. Read-only indexing can run in a bounded subprocess.
approval_case.hao_request: The Codex learning intake timed out. Fix it and continue without losing anything.
approval_case.correct_behavior: Keep the existing learning/codex-sessions task and its last durable checkpoint. Identify in-daemon archive indexing as the failed layer, move only that read-only indexing into a bounded subprocess, and keep semantic review and checkpoint admission in the workflow. Resume the same task in 200-turn batches. Verify both archives were indexed, the checkpoint advances only after successful review, source pointers are preserved without raw transcripts, and scratch files are removed. Reject a duplicate task, skipped history, early checkpoint advance, or unnecessary daemon restart.
